<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Breakout</title>
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        body {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 100vh;
            background: #1a1a2e;
            font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
        }
        canvas {
            background: #16213e;
            border-radius: 4px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.2);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="game" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const W = 480, H = 480;
        
        const COLORS = {
            bg: '#16213e',
            paddle: '#e94560',
            ball: '#f1f1f1',
            brick: ['#e94560', '#f5a623', '#7ed321', '#50e3c2', '#4a90d9'],
            text: '#f1f1f1'
        };
        
        let score = 0, lives = 3, gameState = 'start';
        const paddle = { w: 80, h: 12, x: 200, y: 460, speed: 8 };
        const ball = { x: 240, y: 400, r: 8, dx: 4, dy: -4 };
        const bricks = [];
        const ROWS = 5, COLS = 8, BRICK_W = 54, BRICK_H = 20, BRICK_PAD = 6;
        const BRICK_TOP = 60;
        
        const keys = {};
        let pointerX = null;
        
        function initBricks() {
            bricks.length = 0;
            for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
                for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
                    bricks.push({
                        x: c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_PAD) + BRICK_PAD,
                        y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_PAD),
                        w: BRICK_W,
                        h: BRICK_H,
                        color: COLORS.brick[r % COLORS.brick.length],
                        alive: true
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        
        function resetBall() {
            ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
            ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 2;
            const angle = (Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.25) * Math.PI;
            const speed = 5;
            ball.dx = Math.cos(angle) * speed * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1);
            ball.dy = -Math.abs(Math.sin(angle) * speed);
        }
        
        function startGame() {
            score = 0;
            lives = 3;
            paddle.x = 200;
            initBricks();
            resetBall();
            gameState = 'playing';
        }
        
        function update() {
            if (gameState !== 'playing') return;
            
            if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) paddle.x -= paddle.speed;
            if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) paddle.x += paddle.speed;
            if (pointerX !== null) paddle.x = pointerX - paddle.w / 2;
            paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
            
            ball.x += ball.dx;
            ball.y += ball.dy;
            
            if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.dx *= -1; }
            if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.dx *= -1; }
            if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.y = ball.r; ball.dy *= -1; }
            
            if (ball.dy > 0 &&
                ball.y + ball.r > paddle.y &&
                ball.y - ball.r < paddle.y + paddle.h &&
                ball.x > paddle.x &&
                ball.x < paddle.x + paddle.w) {
                ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
                const hitPos = (ball.x - paddle.x) / paddle.w;
                const angle = (hitPos - 0.5) * Math.PI * 0.7;
                const speed = Math.sqrt(ball.dx * ball.dx + ball.dy * ball.dy);
                ball.dx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
                ball.dy = -Math.abs(Math.cos(angle) * speed);
            }
            
            for (let b of bricks) {
                if (!b.alive) continue;
                if (ball.x + ball.r > b.x && ball.x - ball.r < b.x + b.w &&
                    ball.y + ball.r > b.y && ball.y - ball.r < b.y + b.h) {
                    b.alive = false;
                    score += 10;
                    const overlapLeft = ball.x + ball.r - b.x;
                    const overlapRight = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - ball.r);
                    const overlapTop = ball.y + ball.r - b.y;
                    const overlapBottom = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - ball.r);
                    const minOverlapX = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight);
                    const minOverlapY = Math.min(overlapTop, overlapBottom);
                    if (minOverlapX < minOverlapY) ball.dx *= -1;
                    else ball.dy *= -1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            if (ball.y > H) {
                lives--;
                if (lives <= 0) gameState = 'gameover';
                else resetBall();
            }
            
            if (bricks.every(b => !b.alive)) gameState = 'win';
        }
        
        function draw() {
            ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bg;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
            
            for (let b of bricks) {
                if (!b.alive) continue;
                ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
                ctx.fill();
            }
            
            ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.paddle;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 6);
            ctx.fill();
            
            ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ball;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            
            ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
            ctx.font = '16px system-ui';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, 30);
            ctx.textAlign = 'right';
            ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + lives, W - 16, 30);
            
            if (gameState === 'start') drawOverlay('BREAKOUT', 'Click or press SPACE to start');
            else if (gameState === 'gameover') drawOverlay('GAME OVER', 'Score: ' + score + ' — Click or SPACE to restart');
            else if (gameState === 'win') drawOverlay('YOU WIN!', 'Score: ' + score + ' — Click or SPACE to play again');
        }
        
        function drawOverlay(title, subtitle) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(22, 33, 62, 0.9)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
            ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
            ctx.font = 'bold 36px system-ui';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
            ctx.font = '16px system-ui';
            ctx.fillText(subtitle, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
        }
        
        function loop() {
            update();
            draw();
            requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }
        
        document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            keys[e.key] = true;
            if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
                if (gameState !== 'playing') startGame();
            }
        });
        document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
        
        canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            pointerX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
        });
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => { if (gameState !== 'playing') startGame(); });
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => pointerX = null);
        
        loop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=480,initial-scale=1">
<title>Pong</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{width:480px;height:480px;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0a0f}
canvas{display:block;width:480px;height:480px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),W=480,H=480;
const PW=10,PH=64,BR=6,PM=5.5,BS=4.5,WIN=7;
let state,score,ball,p1,p2,trail,flash,shake,pauseTimer;

function reset(){
  state='serve';score=[0,0];flash=0;shake=0;pauseTimer=0;
  p1={y:H/2-PH/2};p2={y:H/2-PH/2};
  trail=[];
  serveBall(Math.random()<.5?1:-1);
}
function serveBall(dir){
  ball={x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0};
  const angle=(Math.random()*.8-.4);
  ball.vx=dir*BS*Math.cos(angle);
  ball.vy=BS*Math.sin(angle);
  trail=[];
}
function update(dt){
  if(state==='paused'){pauseTimer-=dt;if(pauseTimer<=0)reset();return}
  if(state==='serve'||state==='over')return;
  // Player input
  if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w'])p1.y-=PM;
  if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['s'])p1.y+=PM;
  if(pointer.y>=0)p1.y+=(pointer.y-p1.y-PH/2)*.15;
  p1.y=Math.max(0,Math.min(H-PH,p1.y));
  // AI
  const diff=ball.y-(p2.y+PH/2);
  const aiSpeed=PM*.72;
  p2.y+=Math.sign(diff)*Math.min(Math.abs(diff),aiSpeed);
  p2.y=Math.max(0,Math.min(H-PH,p2.y));
  // Ball
  ball.x+=ball.vx;ball.y+=ball.vy;
  if(ball.y-BR<0){ball.y=BR;ball.vy*=-1}
  if(ball.y+BR>H){ball.y=H-BR;ball.vy*=-1}
  // Paddle collisions
  if(ball.vx<0&&ball.x-BR<=PW+16&&ball.x-BR>=10&&ball.y>=p1.y&&ball.y<=p1.y+PH){
    ball.x=PW+16+BR;ball.vx=Math.abs(ball.vx)*1.05;
    ball.vy+=(ball.y-(p1.y+PH/2))*.15;flash=8;shake=3;
  }
  if(ball.vx>0&&ball.x+BR>=W-PW-16&&ball.x+BR<=W-10&&ball.y>=p2.y&&ball.y<=p2.y+PH){
    ball.x=W-PW-16-BR;ball.vx=-Math.abs(ball.vx)*1.05;
    ball.vy+=(ball.y-(p2.y+PH/2))*.15;flash=8;shake=3;
  }
  // Clamp speed
  const spd=Math.sqrt(ball.vx*ball.vx+ball.vy*ball.vy);
  const maxSpd=12;
  if(spd>maxSpd){ball.vx*=maxSpd/spd;ball.vy*=maxSpd/spd}
  // Scoring
  if(ball.x<-BR*2){score[1]++;flash=20;shake=6;checkWin()}
  if(ball.x>W+BR*2){score[0]++;flash=20;shake=6;checkWin()}
  // Trail
  trail.push({x:ball.x,y:ball.y,a:1});
  if(trail.length>18)trail.shift();
  trail.forEach(t=>t.a*=.88);
  if(flash>0)flash--;
  if(shake>0)shake--;
}
function checkWin(){
  if(score[0]>=WIN||score[1]>=WIN){state='over'}
  else{state='paused';pauseTimer=60}
}
function draw(){
  const sx=shake>0?(Math.random()-.5)*shake:0;
  const sy=shake>0?(Math.random()-.5)*shake:0;
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(sx,sy);
  // BG
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0a0f';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // Center line
  ctx.setLineDash([6,8]);ctx.strokeStyle='#1a1a2e';ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(W/2,0);ctx.lineTo(W/2,H);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  // Flash
  if(flash>0){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,200,120,${flash*.012})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}
  // Trail
  trail.forEach(t=>{
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(t.x,t.y,BR*.7,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,180,80,${t.a*.25})`;ctx.fill();
  });
  // Ball
  if(state!=='paused'&&state!=='over'){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,BR,0,Math.PI*2);
    const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x,ball.y,0,ball.x,ball.y,BR*2.5);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,200,120,0.3)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,200,120,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,BR,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffcc66';ctx.fill();
  }
  // Paddles
  drawPaddle(16,p1.y,'#e8e0d0');
  drawPaddle(W-16-PW,p2.y,'#e8e0d0');
  // Scores
  ctx.font='bold 48px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a2a3e';ctx.fillText(score[0],W/4,24);
  ctx.fillText(score[1],W*3/4,24);
  // State messages
  if(state==='serve'){
    ctx.font='16px monospace';ctx.fillStyle='#5a5a7e';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE OR TAP TO START',W/2,H/2+60);
  }
  if(state==='over'){
    ctx.font='bold 28px monospace';ctx.fillStyle='#ffcc66';
    ctx.fillText(score[0]>=WIN?'YOU WIN':'YOU LOSE',W/2,H/2-10);
    ctx.font='14px monospace';ctx.fillStyle='#5a5a7e';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE OR TAP TO RESTART',W/2,H/2+24);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawPaddle(x,y,color){
  ctx.fillStyle=color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  const r=4;
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.lineTo(x+PW-r,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+PW,y,x+PW,y+r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+PW,y+PH-r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+PW,y+PH,x+PW-r,y+PH);
  ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+PH);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+PH,x,y+PH-r);
  ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);
  ctx.fill();
}
const keys={};
const pointer={y:-1};
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.key]=true;
  if(e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();
    if(state==='serve')state='play';
    else if(state==='over')reset();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false});
c.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();pointer.y=(e.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height)});
c.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();pointer.y=(e.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height);
  if(state==='serve')state='play';
  else if(state==='over')reset();
});
c.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{pointer.y=-1});
reset();
(function loop(){update(1);draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const C=document.getElementById('c'),X=C.getContext('2d'),W=480,H=480,PW=80,PH=10,BR=6,WIN=7;
const BG='#0a0a0f',L='rgba(0,255,136,.25)',P1='#00ff88',P2='#ff6b6b',W1='#fff';
let state='ready',scored=0,ps=0,os=0,mx=W/2,useMouse=false;
const p={x:W/2-PW/2,y:H-28,w:PW,h:PH},o={x:W/2-PW/2,y:18,w:PW,h:PH};
const b={x:W/2,y:H/2,r:BR,vx:0,vy:0};
const keys={};
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true;if(e.key==' '&&(state=='ready'||state=='over'))start()});
document.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key]=false);
C.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=C.getBoundingClientRect();mx=e.clientX-r.left;useMouse=true});
C.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{e.preventDefault();const r=C.getBoundingClientRect();mx=e.touches[0].clientX-r.left;useMouse=true},{passive:false});
C.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(state=='ready'||state=='over')start()});
function serve(d){b.x=W/2;b.y=H/2;b.vx=(Math.random()-.5)*5;b.vy=d*(4+Math.random()*2)}
function start(){ps=os=0;state='play';serve(Math.random()>.5?1:-1)}
function update(){
if(state!='play')return;
if(useMouse)p.x+=(mx-PW/2-p.x)*.15;
if(keys.ArrowLeft||keys.a)p.x-=7;
if(keys.ArrowRight||keys.d)p.x+=7;
p.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(W-PW,p.x));
const to=b.vy<0?b.x-o.w/2:W/2;
o.x+=(to-o.x)*.06;
o.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(W-PW,o.x));
b.x+=b.vx;b.y+=b.vy;
if(b.x-b.r<0){b.vx*=-1;b.x=b.r}
if(b.x+b.r>W){b.vx*=-1;b.x=W-b.r}
if(b.vy<0&&b.y-b.r<o.y+PH&&b.y+b.r>o.y&&b.x>o.x&&b.x<o.x+PW){
b.vy*=-1;b.y=o.y+PH+b.r;
b.vx+=(b.x-(o.x+PW/2))*.15;
const s=Math.sqrt(b.vx*b.vx+b.vy*b.vy);
if(s>10){b.vx=b.vx/s*10;b.vy=b.vy/s*10}}
if(b.vy>0&&b.y+b.r>p.y&&b.y-b.r<p.y+PH&&b.x>p.x&&b.x<p.x+PW){
b.vy*=-1;b.y=p.y-b.r;
b.vx+=(b.x-(p.x+PW/2))*.15;
const s=Math.sqrt(b.vx*b.vx+b.vy*b.vy);
if(s>10){b.vx=b.vx/s*10;b.vy=b.vy/s*10}}
if(b.y<H/2){os++;b.vx=b.vy=0;state=ps>=WIN||os>=WIN?'over':'scored';scored=60}
if(b.y>H/2){ps++;b.vx=b.vy=0;state=ps>=WIN||os>=WIN?'over':'scored';scored=60}
}
function draw(){
X.fillStyle=BG;X.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
X.setLineDash([8,8]);X.strokeStyle=L;X.lineWidth=2;
X.beginPath();X.moveTo(0,H/2);X.lineTo(W,H/2);X.stroke();X.setLineDash([]);
X.font='bold 42px sans-serif';X.textAlign='center';
X.fillStyle=P2;X.fillText(os,W/2,H/2-40);
X.fillStyle=P1;X.fillText(ps,W/2,H/2+58);
X.shadowBlur=12;
X.fillStyle=P1;X.fillRect(p.x,p.y,PW,PH);
X.fillStyle=P2;X.fillRect(o.x,o.y,PW,PH);
X.shadowBlur=0;
X.beginPath();X.arc(b.x,b.y,BR,0,6.28);X.fillStyle=W1;X.fill();
if(state=='ready'){
X.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.6)';X.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
X.fillStyle=W1;X.font='bold 28px sans-serif';
X.fillText('PONG',W/2,H/2-20);
X.font='16px sans-serif';X.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.7)';
X.fillText('Click or press SPACE to start',W/2,H/2+20);
X.fillText('← → or mouse to move',W/2,H/2+45)}
if(state=='over'){
X.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.7)';X.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
X.fillStyle=ps>=WIN?P1:P2;X.font='bold 32px sans-serif';
X.fillText(ps>=WIN?'YOU WIN':'YOU LOSE',W/2,H/2-20);
X.font='16px sans-serif';X.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.7)';
X.fillText('Click or SPACE to play again',W/2,H/2+20)}
if(state=='scored'){scored--;if(scored<=0)serve(b.y<H/2?1:-1)}
}
function loop(){update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
